name: Short ATM straddle every session, 09:20 to 15:15, stop at 30% of the credit
why: Legacy app Lab (Oct 2026): of 48,000 rules only straddle selling showed moderate / strong evidence out of sample (needs Rs 1-2 lakh margin). The common intraday form: sell the ATM call and put at 09:20, buy back at 15:15, stop when the loss is 30% of the premium received.
source: Legacy Stockway Strategy Lab (roadmap part K-M), Mandeep 13 Nov 2026
